comparison.objective: Hang a tool-less server rail in a four-post rack, rear end first and then front.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert and latch one rail end, extend the telescoping rail, then align and latch the opposite end level.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends latched at the marked rack unit, rail level, hands clear for 2 s.
comparison.reason: Sequential rack-rail latching and extension do not exercise loose-media dynamics or selective screening.
